uutiset.s: Kymera Therapeutics Inc. is seeking to raise $1.5 billion in a share sale, according to a statement.

uutiset.t: Jensen Huang Returns to Nvidia Offices
uutiset.s: Jensen Huang returned to the company’s Santa Clara, California, offices on Monday to applause and cheers from employees who shared videos. He spoke with them briefly at one of the entrances (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Wall Street Storms Back as AI Trade Rebounds With Huang’s Return
uutiset.s: US stocks staged a stunning rally on Monday, bouncing back from last week’s brutal technology-led selloff as the surprise return of Jensen Huang to lead Nvidia Corp. propelled Wall Street to its best day since April 2025.

uutiset.t: Trump Puts a Floor Under AI Trade With Push for Huang’s Return
uutiset.s: In the heat of Friday’s meltdown, Wall Street wondered what could stop the bleeding in the artificial intelligence trade that had been powering the stock market for years but was suddenly on the ropes.

uutiset.s: The US-backed firm working to help revive Venezuela’s oil production plans to sign a dredging deal to make it easier to export from a lake in the heart of the nation’s oldest oilfields.

uutiset.s: A former Volkswagen AG engineer admitted trading on secret information about the German carmaker’s planned $5 billion joint venture with electric-vehicle maker Rivian Automotive Inc.

uutiset.t: Goldman Says Dollar ‘Has Some Fight’ Left on Rates Path
uutiset.s: The US dollar rally has legs, with rising interest rates spurring the currency further before it weakens “modestly” next year, according to Kamakshya Trivedi at Goldman Sachs Group Inc.

uutiset.t: Nvidia’s 31% Surge Exposes Wall Street’s Growing Stock Trap
uutiset.s: Monday’s spectacular stock rebound exposes the latest trap facing investors in a market dominated by a handful of technology giants: Selling them offers protection when markets plunge, but risks missing the recovery.

uutiset.t: Credit Fear Gauge Drops as Huang’s Return Boosts AI Hopes
uutiset.s: Corporate-debt markets rallied globally on Monday, with US fear gauges improving the most in weeks and technology firms’ bonds rebounding after Nvidia Corp.’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as chief executive officer.
